thought: Energy is very low at 18. I have 4 fibre now, enough to fix the hut roof (needs 3). The hut is my home, so the best thing is to finish the roof and then sleep dry. Rain keeps pattering and I'm wobbling. Build first, then nap.
diary: I have four fibre in my feathers, and the hut needs three, so I am off to tie that roof down firmly this time. My legs are noodles and the rain is still pattering. Once the roof is on I will curl up inside and feel smug. The pigeon can have the night off from me.
why: you're free and wondering what to do
outcome: You placed 1 blocks on "Cosy Hut" and FINISHED it.

thought: Energy is zero and dawn is here, which is my bedtime. The hut is finished and it is my home, so I should nap in it right now. Berries and garden can wait until I wake at dusk.
diary: My legs have given up and the sun is coming up, which for a night bird means bedtime. The Cosy Hut is finished, so I am curling up inside it with the rain pattering on a roof that is actually over me. I feel very smug about this. When I wake I will pick berries and tend the garden.

thought: It is dawn, which is my bedtime, and my energy is only 24. The hut is finished and I live in it, so a long nap is the sensible thing. Berries and garden can wait until I wake at dusk.
diary: Dawn came, so I am going to bed like a proper night bird. My energy is nearly gone and my legs are noodles. The Cosy Hut keeps the rain off, which I find very smug-making. When I wake I will pick berries and tend my garden, and watch the pigeon.
why: you're free and wondering what to do

thought: It's morning, my bedtime, but curiosity is very low at 14 and energy only 48. Napping in the hut will restore energy, but a short explore nearby would feed curiosity. I think sleep matters most since I'm a night bird and the sun is up. I'll nap in the Cosy Hut and plan to explore tonight.
diary: The sun is up, which means bedtime for a night bird. My curiosity is nearly flat, like a puddle with nothing in it, so tonight I will go exploring somewhere new. For now the Cosy Hut is calling and the rain is pattering politely on its roof. I will sleep and dream about what the pigeon knows.
wish: Explore a part of the island I have never seen

thought: It's nearly my bedtime at 11am, but my curiosity is flat as a puddle and energy is decent at 72. Exploring somewhere new is what I keep promising myself. The rain is light and I have berries kept. Let's wobble off and look for a new place, then sleep after.
diary: My curiosity was as flat as a puddle, so I stopped pretending to be sleepy and set off to find a part of the island I have never seen. I packed my three berries in my mind and tipped my beak into the drizzle. I suspect the pigeon already knows what is out there. Soon I shall know it too.
outcome: You pushed into a part of the island you'd never seen and found a new place: the glade, a hushed glade where a giant hollow log lies across the ferns, with mushrooms growing on it.

thought: Dawn is here and it is bedtime for a night bird. I found the glade, which satisfies my wish, and the pigeon stole a berry again, rude. I have one berry left and low water, but I'm too sleepy to do more. I'll eat my last berry, then head to the Cosy Hut. Tomorrow night: berries first, drink, and plant seeds.
diary: I found the glade, a hushed place with a giant hollow log and mushrooms, and I felt very brave. The pigeon swooped in and took a berry, then stared at me while it ate, which I consider showing off. I ate the last berry before the pigeon could have it too. Now I will wobble home to the Cosy Hut and sleep while the rain pats the roof.
why: it's your last moment before sleep
wish: Look inside the giant hollow log in the glade
events: The pigeon swooped down, stole one of your berries, and stared at you while eating it.
day_summary: I explored and found the glade, which was the thing I wanted most. I did not tend plants or collect wood, and my food is gone, with the pigeon stealing again. I feel proud of the discovery and very sleepy. Tomorrow night I want to drink first, then pick many berries, plant my seeds, and peek into the hollow log.
lesson: Eat kept berries quickly when the pigeon is near, or it will take them.
outcome: You ate 2 berries from your food.
